title: Time derivative of the spatial derivative of a compact variation, with ∂ₜDφₜ|ₜ₌₀ = DX and uniform bounds
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, E := Ambient n ℓ = ℝ^{n+ℓ} (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+ℓ)), Euclidean norm), φ : ℝ → E → E, ε ∈ ℝ and K ⊆ E, and assume IsCompactVariation φ ε K (Simon Ch. 4, 2.1), i.e. (H1) ε > 0; (H2) K is compact; (H3) (t, y) ↦ φ t y is C^∞ on (−ε, ε) × E; (H4) for every t ∈ (−ε, ε), φ t is bijective and Function.invFun (φ t) is C^∞ on E; (H5) φ 0 y = y for all y; (H6) φ t y = y for all t ∈ (−ε, ε) and y ∉ K. Let X(y) := deriv (t ↦ φ t y) 0. Then there is Λ' : ℝ → E → L(E, E) such that (i) for every x ∈ E, Λ'(0, x) = fderiv ℝ X x, and for every t ∈ (−ε, ε) the map s ↦ fderiv ℝ (φ s) x has derivative Λ'(t, x) at s = t; and (ii) for every δ ∈ ℝ with 0 < δ < ε there is B ∈ ℝ such that ‖Λ'(t, x)‖ ≤ B for all x ∈ E and t ∈ (−δ, δ).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (φ : ℝ → Ambient n ℓ → Ambient n ℓ) (ε : ℝ) (K : Set (Ambient n ℓ)), IsCompactVariation φ ε K → ∃ Λ' : ℝ → Ambient n ℓ → (Ambient n ℓ →L[ℝ] Ambient n ℓ), (∀ x, Λ' 0 x = fderiv ℝ (fun y ↦ deriv (fun t ↦ φ t y) 0) x ∧ ∀ t ∈ Ioo (-ε) ε, HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ fderiv ℝ (φ s) x) (Λ' t x) t) ∧ ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < ε → ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ x, ∀ t ∈ Ioo (-δ) δ, ‖Λ' t x‖ ≤ B
